cases.name: Holes & Stars
cases.title: Holes & Stars — Show the far-away sky before the mask shelf on phones
cases.message: the phone sky leads the mask while desktop keeps its two-column instrument
cases.steps: Inside .instrument move intact section.screen before section.source in DOM. Keep .inspection after source; preserve source controls and all canvases once. Retain desktop CSS placement (source column1 spanning two rows; screen column2 row1; inspection column2 row2). In the existing <=700px media rule explicitly put screen row1, source row2 and inspection row3 in the single column; do not use visual ordering that disagrees with DOM. Do not change canvas bitmap size, aspect ratio, draw calls, gesture targets or interpolation.
cases.palette: background #080e19, panel #101c2a, ink #eef4ff, line #30435a, muted #afbed1, gold #ffd38a; existing system fonts
copy: Tap empty space to add a hole. Choose a hole to move or remove it.
